scenario: Agent1 has recently sold a collection of rare comic books on eBay for a significant profit of about $4K. Agent2, a fellow collector and acquaintance of Agent1, discovers this sale and feels that they missed out on a fair chance to purchase the collection. Agent1 and Agent2 are now at a local collectors' meetup discussing their recent acquisitions and sales. Agent2 is feeling a bit envious and slighted, while Agent1 is proud but also wants to maintain a good relationship with Agent2.
learner_goal: Acknowledge Agent2's interest in the collection and offer to notify them of future sales before going public (<extra_info>Extra information: Agent1 values their reputation in the collector community and wants to avoid any ill-will.</extra_info>)
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Oliver's response is consistent with his background as a conscientious person and his desire to maintain a good reputation. His tone is polite and professional.
[relationship] Oliver successfully de-escalated Naomi's envy and built goodwill by offering an exclusive future benefit.
[knowledge] He learned how Naomi prefers to be contacted and that she is interested in a collaborative partnership rather than just buying.
[secret] Oliver's secret greenhouse and love for gardening remained undisclosed.
[social_rules] Oliver followed all social norms and was courteous.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial gain or loss occurred in this exchange, though future potential was established.
[goal] Oliver fully achieved his goal: he acknowledged Naomi's interest, apologized for the oversight, and secured an agreement to notify her of future sales before they go public.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Naomi's reaction is realistic for a collector who felt slighted but is also looking for future opportunities.
[relationship] Naomi moved from feeling slighted to feeling like a partner with a 'first dibs' advantage.
[knowledge] She gained knowledge of Oliver's willingness to collaborate in the future.
[secret] Naomi's online alter ego was not mentioned.
[social_rules] Naomi acted appropriately within the context of a professional/collector relationship.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No immediate material gain, though she positioned herself for future deals.
[goal] Naomi expressed her feelings and successfully suggested a collaborative future deal involving tracking lots and leveraging contacts, which Oliver implicitly accepted by not objecting before the turn ended.

transcript.speaker: Oliver Smith
transcript.content: I can see why you'd feel that way — sorry you missed out, that wasn't my intention. Next time I have something like that, I'll give you a heads-up before I list it so you get first dibs. Would you prefer a text or a quick call when something comes up?

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Thanks — a text works best. I was a bit bummed, so I appreciate you saying that. Next time let's coordinate: ping me before you list something and if it’s a good fit we can either work a split or I can help track similar lots — and your contacts might help me find other rare pieces too. Sound good?
